title: Spanish Fried Courgette
description: A keto-friendly Spanish-inspired dish featuring crispy fried courgette.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced courgette and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Continue cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the courgette is tender and lightly browned.
Increase heat to high and add the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil.
Fry the courgette for an additional 2-3 minutes, until crispy and golden brown.
